component.name: MainScene
component.script:
sub init() m.welcomeText = m.top.findNode("welcomeText") m.movieGrid = m.top.findNode("movieGrid")
' Trigger our Go Orchestrator m.loadTask = CreateObject("roSGNode", "NetworkTask") ' REPLACE THIS WITH YOUR ACTUAL LOCAL IP m.loadTask.url = "http://192.168.1.50:8080/catalog/movie/top" m.loadTask.observeField("content", "onContentReceived") m.loadTask.control = "RUN" end sub
sub onContentReceived() if m.loadTask.content <> invalid m.welcomeText.visible = false m.movieGrid.content = m.loadTask.content m.movieGrid.visible = true m.movieGrid.setFocus(true) end if end sub
